```{r}
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = shinytheme("superhero"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("year",
                  label = "choose year",
                  min = 1980,
                  max = 2022,
                  value = 2000,
                  step = 1,
                  sep = "")
    ),
    
    mainPanel (
      leafletOutput("map", height = "500px")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
